providers.coverage: individual cards whose text and markings were read from a seller's listing photograph
providers.attribution: Seller listing photograph via Cardmarket.
providers.notes: Tier 2, below an owner-inspected specimen: the card text is legible, but it cannot be re-examined and the seller may have mislabelled the language. Positive evidence only: a listing's absence proves nothing, and the language filter above it is not evidence at all. No open API; collection is by hand or a browser session, subject to a rolling ~55-request quota before HTTP 429.
